claims.claim: A study of 670 students in Concepción, Cali and Lima found that anchoring and adjustment influenced forecasts of the S&P MILA Pacific Alliance Select index.

claims.source_title: Effect of heuristic anchoring and adjustment, and optimism bias, in stock market forecasts
claims.supporting_quote: The results were analyzed using the least squares method, and the data panel confirmed that the anchoring and adjustment heuristic influences the forecast of the financial index used in the study.

claims.claim: Survey forecasts of macroeconomic statistics systematically underpredict those statistics, and stock prices move on the anticipated components of macro announcements.
claims.episode_span: Those forecasts systematically underpredict the statistics.
claims.source_title: Economic forecasts, anchoring bias, and stock returns
claims.supporting_quote: The forecasts systematically underpredict macroeconomic statistics and the forecast errors are predicted by past macroeconomic announcements.

claims.claim: In an online prediction market, forecasters who first estimated blind to the market moved closer once they saw it, and their accuracy matched forecasters who could always see the market.
claims.episode_span: Accuracy was similar in both conditions.
claims.source_title: Interval Elicitation of Forecasts in a Prediction Market Reveals Lack of Anchoring "Bias"
claims.supporting_quote: Their first edits to the market forecast were very similar to the first edits of forecasters who could always see the current state of the market, and forecasters in both conditions had similar accuracy.
